visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Casting Without Checking the Type
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The program should print Fetching! twice and then Dogs: 2, but it crashes with a ClassCastException when it reaches the cat.

solution.explanation: A cast tells the compiler to trust you, but the check happens at run time. A Cat is not a Dog, so the cast throws ClassCastException. Guard the cast with instanceof.
